answer: An oasis of verified identity can be built by issuing each agent a slow-season credential, much like cassava landraces are multiplied from tested stem cuttings rather than seed. Every new agent must be rooted through a knoll of trusted introducers who vouch over weeks, so a sybil farm must recruit many independent vouchers and wait out the quarantine. The vine of trust stays costly to forge because each fake identity drains vouchers' limited reputational stock, though colluding cliques can still concentrate risk.
